303B.4 / CHAPTER 4 OF 6

Dev economics & incentives

How does the team benefit—and where does that value go?

6 chapters with worked investigations

01Read inventory, not green buys02Dev Cycle / Buyer Cycle03Alignment, divergence & extraction04Dev economics & incentives05Token fees vs trading fees06Visible wallet vs economic position

01Definition

Team economics can combine creator fees, token inventory, treasury funds, LP income, and product or service revenue.

02Why it matters

A revenue stream can reward trading activity without proving long-term buyer alignment.

03What to check

  • Who earns fees, inventory proceeds, and treasury income
  • Marketing spend, delivery, and verifiable reinvestment
  • Liquidity rights, permissions, and repeated launch history

04Healthy / Dangerous

Healthy

Revenue sources and use of funds are disclosed and traceable.

Dangerous

Fee income or a treasury label substitutes for evidence of alignment.

05Beginner mistake

Assuming creator revenue means the team wants what holders want.

06Takeaway

Revenue explains incentives; it does not certify alignment.

ILLUSTRATIVE · NOT A LIVE TOKEN

See the idea

  1. 01

    A creator earns fees while trading remains active.

  2. 02

    Inventory also sells into repeated attention bursts.

  3. 03

    Review both income streams and their use, not fees alone.

WORKED INVESTIGATION · ILLUSTRATIVE

Work through the evidence

Mechanism and worked case

Suppose $100,000 of fee-bearing volume generates a documented 1% fee, of which 30% goes to the creator. Gross fee is $1,000 and creator allocation is $300 before claims or further deductions. Accrued allocation is not necessarily a completed payout.

How to investigate it

Read the current platform or contract rule, recipient addresses, calculation basis, claim mechanism, and change permissions. Verify actual payouts and documented spend separately. Add inventory sale proceeds and treasury flows only when supported; do not count internal transfers twice.

Check your reasoning — answered

A badge says Pay Dev and volume rises. Can you calculate creator earnings from volume alone? No. Establish the exact signal meaning, rate, allocation, claim status, and transaction evidence first.

Trace it externally

Verify protocol rules, fee recipients, treasury records, LP rights, and project claims. Meme Fast does not audit team revenue or spending.

Go deeper

Keep creator fee shares, token-specific transfer charges, LP income, network fees, and product revenue separate. Marketing budgets and repeated launches change incentives but do not prove misconduct. LP rights can combine fee income with control over liquidity. A treasury transfer may be spending, custody, or distribution; establish the destination and purpose before interpreting it.
